title: UFO, Aliens are real? Donald Trump reveals 'real deal' Air Force pilots told US President about 'strange' flying object faster than F-22 fighter jet
excerpt: Donald Trump directed his administration to provide more transparency on questions of Unidentified Flying Objects (UFOs) and alien life.
content:
US President Donald Trump has revealed that Air Force pilots informed him that they saw a mysterious object flew past F-22 fighter jet at three times its speed. This has raised the talks surrounding Unidentified Flying Objects (UFOs), as per a report.

President Trump made the revelations during CBS "60 minutes". Trump told the host, he was not a believer in UFOs but he had conversations with Air Force Pilots regarding the topic at the Oval office. He termed the pilots and information "the real deal" and 'strange', Fox News reported.

Trump described the mystery flying object as lightening fast, round and not so 'aerodynamic'.


Earlier this year, Trump directed his administration to provide more transparency on questions of UFOs and alien life. So far, the Pentagon has released three batches of files ranging from decades-old FBI reports to more recent military videos showing orbs darting or soaring through the sky.

Trump’s directive led to the creation of a UAP Governance Board overseen by the Office of the Director of National Intelligence.

Earlier this year, Pentagon released new files on UFOs, saying members of the public can draw their own conclusions on “unidentified anomalous phenomena” like an object that a drone pilot said shone a bright light in the sky and then vanished.

A newly unveiled website housing the documents on unidentified anomalous phenomena, or UAPs, has a decidedly retro feel, with black-and-white military imagery of flying objects displayed prominently on the page, with statements displayed in typewriter-like font. The first release included 162 files, such as old State Department cables, FBI documents and transcripts from NASA of crewed flights into space.

The Pentagon has been working on declassifying documents related to UFOs for years, and Congress created an office in 2022 to declassify material. Its 2024 debut report revealed hundreds of new UAP incidents but found no evidence that the U.S. government had ever confirmed a sighting of alien technology, AP reported.

The US Congress ordered the Pentagon to begin releasing decades of files on UFO sightings in 2022 as some members of the military shared encounters with unexplained aircraft.
